name: Match page renders a stage badge for the fixture
description: When a visitor opens a match permalink, the page renders a stage badge identifying the round (R32, R16, QF, SF, F, 3P) or the group letter (A through L).

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Verify the match detail page renders a stage badge whose text matches a knockout round label or a group letter from A through L
